results.question: How many days of annual leave do I get?
results.answer: According to the leave policy, full-time employees are entitled to 21 working days of paid annual leave per year.

results.question: How many leave days after 10 years of service?
results.answer: 30 working days.

results.question: How early must I request a long leave?
results.answer: According to p.1 of the leave policy, for a long leave request (longer than 5 working days), you must submit the request at least 14 days in advance through the HR portal and approved by the direct manager.

results.question: Can I carry over unused annual leave?
results.answer: Yes, up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over to the next year.

results.question: When do carried-over leave days expire?
results.answer: According to the leave policy, any remaining unused annual leave days expire on 31 March.

results.question: How many paid sick days per year?
results.answer: 15 days of paid sick leave per year.

results.question: When do I need a medical certificate?
results.answer: According to the leave policy (p.1), a medical certificate is required when the absence lasts more than 2 consecutive days.

results.question: How long is maternity leave?
results.answer: 90 calendar days.

results.question: When must paternity leave be taken?
results.answer: Paternity leave must be taken within 30 days of the birth.

results.question: How many days of emergency leave are there?
results.answer: There are 3 working days of emergency leave available per year.

results.question: How long can unpaid leave be?
results.answer: Up to 30 days.

results.question: What are the standard working hours?
results.answer: The standard working hours are 9:00 to 17:00, Sunday to Thursday.

results.question: What are the core hours?
results.answer: The core hours are 10:00 to 15:00.

results.question: How is overtime paid?
results.answer: Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate.

results.question: How many days can I work remotely?
results.answer: According to the policy, you can work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.

results.question: Can I work from home during probation?
results.answer: No, employees in their probation period (first 3 months) cannot work remotely.

results.question: When must I report a lost device?
results.answer: According to the Security Requirements section in the working hours and remote work document, lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT within 24 hours.

results.question: How much is the transport allowance?
results.answer: The transport allowance is 1,500 EGP per month.

results.question: Does health insurance cover my family?
results.answer: Yes, health insurance covers up to 3 dependents (spouse and children).

results.question: How big is the annual bonus?
results.answer: According to the benefits and insurance policy (p.2), the annual performance bonus is up to one month of salary.

results.question: What is the yearly training budget?
results.answer: 20,000 EGP per year.

results.question: What is the hotel limit per night when traveling?
What is the daily meal allowance on trips?
results.answer: According to the context, the daily meal allowance during travel is 600 EGP.

results.question: How fast must I submit expense receipts?
results.answer: Within 10 working days after the trip.

results.question: Which expense claims need director approval?
results.answer: According to the Business Travel and Expenses Policy (p.2), expense claims above 5,000 EGP need approval from the department director.

results.question: How much is the mileage reimbursement?
results.answer: The mileage reimbursement is 4 EGP per kilometer.
